mapper.sql: uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, name, is_default, created_at, updated_at, archived_at, compartment_id, display_color, data_residency, external_key_id, tags, runtime_profile_uuid, COALESCE((SELECT rp.external_id FROM runtime_profiles rp WHERE rp.uuid = workspaces.runtime_profile_uuid), '') AS runtime_profile_external_id, COALESCE((SELECT rp.name FROM runtime_profiles rp WHERE rp.uuid = workspaces.runtime_profile_uuid), '') AS runtime_profile_name, COALESCE((SELECT rp.provider_kind FROM runtime_profiles rp WHERE rp.uuid = workspaces.runtime_profile_uuid), '') AS runtime_provider_kind

w.uuid, w.external_id, w.organization_uuid, w.name, w.is_default, w.created_at, w.updated_at, w.archived_at, w.compartment_id, w.display_color, w.data_residency, w.external_key_id, w.tags, w.runtime_profile_uuid, COALESCE(rp.external_id, '') AS runtime_profile_external_id, COALESCE(rp.name, '') AS runtime_profile_name, COALESCE(rp.provider_kind, '') AS runtime_provider_kind
mapper.select: SELECT created_at, uuid FROM workspaces WHERE organization_uuid = #{organizationUUID} AND external_id = #{externalID} AND NOT is_default

SELECT
FROM workspaces w LEFT JOIN runtime_profiles rp ON rp.uuid = w.runtime_profile_uuid
w.organization_uuid = #{organizationUUID} AND NOT w.is_default
AND w.archived_at IS NULL
AND (w.created_at, w.uuid) > (#{anchor.CreatedAt}, #{anchor.UUID})
AND (w.created_at, w.uuid) < (#{anchor.CreatedAt}, #{anchor.UUID})
ORDER BY w.created_at DESC, w.uuid DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workspaces (external_id, organization_uuid, name, is_default) VALUES (#{externalID}, #{organizationUUID}, #{name}, TRUE) ON CONFLICT (external_id) DO UPDATE SET organization_uuid = excluded.organization_uuid, name = excluded.name, is_default = TRUE RETURNING uuid
